question: Why OpenHOI3 sent Germany's 214. Infanterie-Division to 1306 at noon on 16 July 1941.

addresses.name: CUnitDeployment::DeployAt
addresses.comment: Slot 9: puts the deployment's unit (+0x38) on the map. 0x57D480 to three `ret 4` at 0x57DF86, 0x57DFDB and 0x57E005; 8 int3 then the next function at 0x57E010. `this` in ECX (kept in EBX), one stack argument, the province, handed to CUnit::EnterProvince. It adds the unit to its country's list (0x4E06F0, the country from +0x30/+0x34) and enters the province; where the country's auto_assign_leaders (+0x74B) is set, CUnit::AssignBestLeader on the unit (0x57DD73). **Then, on every path, SpreadThreatToAll(&t, &1000, owner) at 0x57DE3B** with t = REGULAR_CONSTRUCTION_THREAT_IMPACT (diplomacy +0xD4), or, where the unit's first regiment is a reserve (CSubUnit +0xA4), t x (1000 + owner.mod[RESERVES_PENALTY_SIZE] (+0x268)) / 1000 x 1000 / 5000 - a fifth. It also calls CCountry::GetActingCapitalLocation on the owner just before and throws the answer away. What follows builds a message ('UNIT') for the player and was not read. Called by CDeployUnitCommand::Execute and by JoinUnit. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leaderassign.md, section 8. **Organisation, read 2026-11-15** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 99): 0x17DCA1-0x17DCD7 walks the unit's brigades and sets each one's organisation (CSubUnit +0x60) to CSubUnit::GetMaxOrganisation(brigade, 0, 1), never below 0, where the first byte of GetCustomGameSettings() (0x1C4E0) is set, else to 0 - so a placed unit starts at no organisation in an ordinary game. Seen: Germany's 214. Infanterie-Division, 50 while waiting, 0 the hour the AI places it.
addresses.evidence: The loop read on the running game's listing; the custom-game settings singleton (0x1685C1C) read with its first byte 0; the division's brigades read from the saves of three runs.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions(CAIUnit* this, void* units, CList* records, bool anyLandUnit, bool withAllies)
addresses.comment:
Fills a position list's have (+0x10) and standing (+0x14). 0x4D9E30, two `ret 0x10`. For each land unit of the vector (divisions only unless anyLandUnit), not retreating or retreating with an organisation share >= 0.5: the records are walked in list order - the first that is its province counts it standing and heading (have and standing +1) unless it is bound for a province not held by an enemy, when it is counted nowhere; the first that is its destination (GetMovementDestinationProvince) counts it heading. With withAllies, focus areas (+0x340 > 0) and the frontier at war, it recurses over the whole unit list of every non-hostile country other than us that controls a focus area's first province. Callers: CAIUnit_FillLinePositions, CAIUnit_FillGarrisons, CAIUnit_PlaceReserves and itself. The name is ours. Who passes what, on the listing (2026-11-10): CAIUnit_FillLinePositions passes +0x12C, every committed division **garrisons included**, divisions only, with allies; CAIUnit_FillGarrisons its garrison divisions and any land unit, no allies; CAIUnit_PlaceReserves +0x15C, any land unit, no allies. A unit standing in a record whose destination is not held by an enemy (CCountry::IsEnemy) is counted nowhere. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 13.

**The allies' half, read on the listing 2026-11-10** (`FINDINGS-liveread.md`, section 21). With withAllies, focus areas (+0x340 > 0) and the frontier at war (+0x364): for each country on the agent's country's non_hostile_countries (+0xF98) but itself, the focus areas (+0x338) are walked, and at the first whose first province that country controls, the country's whole unit list (+0xBAC) is copied to a vector and this function called over it with the same records and anyLandUnit, withAllies false. Once a country. An area with no provinces answers the tag `---` and id 0. The enemy test on a unit's destination stays the agent's country's. **Logged 2026-11-15** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 99): the record list is a linked list of {record, ?, next} nodes, a record's province pointer at +0, want +0xC, have +0x10, standing +0x14, cap +0x18; CAIUnit_FillLinePositions calls it at 0x4C93D5, after the share and before the carry is handed out, so the wants it sees are the shares before the carry.
addresses.evidence: Breakpoints at the entry and both returns over four passes of 16 July 1941.
